Aurora ovals — thin rayed emission rings centered on each planet's MAGNETIC pole (not the spin pole — a per-body tilt rotates the sampling frame so Neptune's 47° dipole offset reads as an oval swung far off the axis). A second, higher shell carries the curtain tops so the arcs stand off the limb instead of painting a flat cap.
